title: Kitchen Court
logline: In the Delacroix-Huang house every family dispute goes to trial at the kitchen table, because Mom is a real small claims judge and Grandma is a retired referee.
blurb: Every dispute in this house goes to trial at the kitchen table. Mom presides. Grandma referees. The six-year-old is the bailiff. Verdicts end in dessert.

title: Long Route
logline: Six kids at the far end of the county's last long school bus route spend 48 minutes together twice a day, and that bus is where everything happens.
blurb: Six kids, one bus, forty-eight minutes each way. The back row runs a parliament. The driver hears everything. School is the thing that happens between rides.

title: Recent History Society
logline: A sketch show about a historical reenactment society that only reenacts things that happened last week, in full costume, with total seriousness.
blurb: A society of reenactors who only reenact last week. Full costume. Total seriousness. A ten-year-old plays the fire hydrant with too much feeling.

title: The Night Desk
logline: The overnight clerk at a 24-hour hardware store hears the story behind every item that comes back to the returns desk, and every return has a spooky reason.
blurb: After hours at the hardware store, the returns desk takes back the things nobody wants. Some of them hum. Some of them ring. Marguerite needs two receipts.
